verdicts.proof: Old: card_payment_sheet.dart:219-225 _notCompleted() sets _note=psSheetNotCompleted on FailureCode.Canceled (:248-251 card, :280-283 Google Pay); old shows it as 12px amber text :436-447. v2 uses the same State and same handlers; :332 passes note: _processing ? psSheetProcessing : _note to CardSheetV2, rendered at card_sheet_v2.dart:146-149 as MgStateBanner(tone warn, title: note). Only entry is the card sheet's own pay buttons (v2 :319, :331), both through the same _payWithCard/_payWithGooglePay.

Old: Google Pay button rendered only if _googlePayReady (:384), set from Stripe.isPlatformPaySupported (:170-177); onPressed _processing ? null (:386); _payWithGooglePay also returns early when _processing (:260). v2: :318-319 identical condition (_googlePayReady ? _GooglePayButton(onPressed: _processing ? null : _payWithGooglePay) : null), placed by card_sheet_v2.dart:131-141 only when wallet != null. Same in-function guard :260. While running, v2 additionally shows the psSheetProcessing banner (card_sheet_v2.dart:146-149).

Marker is set in _beginSubmit (card_payment_sheet.dart:201-210) via widget.onSubmitting, called from both _payWithCard (:233) and _payWithGooglePay (:264), which are the only pay callbacks wired into the v2 sheet (:319, :331). The callback itself is supplied by the caller independent of the look: payment_screen.dart:1155-1161 (_markSubmitted, _setMarker, _enqueuePaidChange) and shop_checkout_screen.dart:533. Sheet closed mid-payment returns processing (:86-88), shared. Silent in the old look as well (it is a background safeguard).

_resultFor (card_payment_sheet.dart:187-198) maps only Succeeded/RequiresCapture to paid and Processing to processing; used by both pay handlers (:244, :277) in both looks. Caller handles processing in payment_screen.dart after :1166 regardless of look. No v2 code builds its own result.

_cardController.clear() in initState post-frame (card_payment_sheet.dart:131-145) is in the shared State. The same cardField (controller: _cardController, :296-314) is passed to CardSheetV2 (:327) and placed in a keyed CardFieldFrameV2 (card_sheet_v2.dart:142), so the cleared controller is the one shown. Silent in old too.

Flags are set in PaymentErrorSheet.show before the look branch: isDismissible/enableDrag = dismissible (payment_error_sheet.dart:35-36), PopScope canPop: dismissible with back = pop + onButton (:42-50), for both bodies (:51-69). v2 body: error_sheet_v2.dart:44 MgSheetFrame(onClose: dismissible ? null : main) -> ✕ performs main action in terminal state; ✕ is always shown because MgStateSheetBody implements MgSheetDiscBody (mg_state_sheet.dart:25) -> inline close (mg_sheet.dart:171-172, 201). Body pull-to-dismiss only when route isDismissible && enableDrag (mg_sheet.dart:124-128), and any maybePop still hits the PopScope.

Labels/callbacks are chosen in payment_screen_problems.dart:44-140 (_showProblem) and :482-538 (_showDraftFailure) and passed via _showError (:13-33) to PaymentErrorSheet.show; look-independent. v2 renders title (error_sheet_v2.dart:59), full message incl. attempt counter as 'why' (:60; mg_state_sheet.dart Text without maxLines inside scrollable MgSheetFrame), primary ink button calling pop + onButton (:38-41, :46) and ghost secondary pop + onSecondary (:47-55). Only change: mgStripEmoji removes emoji from labels.

The v2 switch is inside PaymentErrorSheet.show (payment_error_sheet.dart:32, :51-60); every caller - payment_screen_problems.dart:23, booking_restore.dart:73/228, reservation_edit_states.dart:115/130/144/178, shop_checkout_screen.dart:356/406/587/615/637 - goes through it with its own dismissible flag. The v2 reservations list reaches restore through the same restoreAndPay (reservations_screen_v2.dart:21, :152). No v2 file shows payment errors by another route (grep for PaymentErrorSheet in v2 dirs found only error_sheet_v2.dart).

signInAgain (payment_ui_helpers.dart:70-75: signOut with 8s timeout, then go /login). Used as the onButton callback by payment_screen_problems.dart:124 and :520, booking_restore.dart:190, shop_checkout_screen.dart:624; the v2 error sheet calls the same onButton (error_sheet_v2.dart:38-41).

_onBack (payment_screen_problems.dart:461-480): when _processing && _submitted -> confirmLeaveRunningPayment, _setMarker, invalidate pendingBookingFabProvider, go reservations. Every v2 exit runs it: PaymentViewV2(onBack: _onBack) at payment_screen.dart:1542, used by the header back (pay_header_v2.dart:41 via payment_view_v2.dart:108) and the pinned back (payment_view_v2.dart:186); system back via BackButtonListener (payment_screen.dart:1508-1514) and PopScope(canPop: !_processing, onPopInvoked -> _onBack) (:1516-1520) wrap both looks. /payment sits inside the ShellRoute (router.dart:371, :418), so tab bar taps are a further exit: both the old bar (app_shell.dart:122) and the v2 bar (app_shell_v2.dart:149) call the shared onShellTabTap, which asks confirmLeaveRunningPayment and runs paymentLeaveActionProvider while paymentProcessingProvider is true (shell_tab_action.dart:29-36); v2 shell FABs/AI button are hidden on the payment screen (app_shell_v2.dart:167).
